name: open-road-scope
description: Cross-platform vehicle data dashboard powered by OBD-II (ELM327)

scripts.build: rimraf out && pnpm typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:unpack: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.config.ts
scripts.build:win: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win
scripts.build:win:nsis: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win nsis
scripts.build:win:portable: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win portable
scripts.build:win:msi: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --win msi
scripts.build:mac: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac
scripts.build:mac:dmg: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg
scripts.build:mac:zip: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac zip
scripts.build:linux: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux
scripts.build:linux:appimage: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux AppImage
scripts.build:linux:deb: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux deb
scripts.build:linux:rpm: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux rpm
scripts.build:linux:snap: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux snap
scripts.build:linux:tar: pnpm build && pnpm build:sidecar && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux tar.gz
